sentences.text: P0 INC-88 is still open: card authorizations via Northstar Bank have been failing since 08:40, route B is at 50% with success back to about 78%, and Northstar blames its HSM cluster with only a "this afternoon" ETA.

Palmway's CFO wants a root cause and firm fix date by end of day tomorrow or he takes it to his board; Karim's PAY-398 fix is clean on staging but needs a prod slot before tonight's 22:00 settlement run, while the team is tied up on the P0.

Three Thursday items are stuck: PR #318 (PAY-409) has no reviewer because Layla is out until Thursday, PAY-412 waits on our reply to KYCly's Sunday email asking for egress IPs and data-residency scope, and Arjun's PAY-405 waits on staging DB creds from Hamdan ("maybe Wed"), which also holds ONB-81.
KYC v2 (PR #316, ONB-64) shipped to production at 09:15 today, and Huda called it the release the bank partners were waiting on.

Two decisions wait on you before the Thursday 12:00 freeze: Sara needs a call on ONB-77, static states (about 2 days, Youssef says doable by Wednesday night) versus moving the CEO's Thursday 4pm demo, and Karim's PR #322 (ADR-014, settlement write path) has been waiting for your review since Monday 14:30.
